text:
Alana (PM): Short thread to agree Phase A for Console observability pilot. Core asks from pilots: route dashboards, trace-link in logs, and per-model cost estimates. Propose a minimal scope to hit pilot in 6 weeks.

Raj (Eng): Agree with minimal scope. For tracing: generate/propagate X-Span-ID and provide a trace URL template per customer. No span retention in v1. Default sample 1%.

Mei (SRE): Storage/ingestion are main concerns. Recommend span metadata retention 7d, aggregated metrics 30d, and a safe-mode to throttle samples to 0.1% on spike. Need an ingestion alert.

Carlos (Data): Cost estimate approach: tokens_in/out * model_unit_cost + routing multiplier. We'll tag events with route_id + model_id and surface a sampled drift metric vs billing.

Priya (CS): Two pilots (FinCorp, MedApp) need trace-links for audits; they accept sampling if flagged errors include a link. Will coordinate pilot access if we can deliver this scope.

Tom (Design): Will deliver three starter dashboard templates and a route-level toggle for tracing. Keep drilldowns as external links to APM in v1.

Alana (PM): Minimal telemetry spec: emit per-request event with route_id, model_id, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, span_id, error_flag. Sampling default 1%, overrides per-customer. Retention: spans 7d, histograms 30d.

Raj (Eng): Will reuse events pipeline; will open RFC with schema changes. 6 weeks is tight but doable if we freeze required fields.

Mei (SRE): :warning: need clear ingestion quotas and a runbook for safe-mode.

Alana (PM): Please react: +1 to accept Phase A or :warning: if you see an unblocker. Planning to freeze scope EOD Friday.
